title: Dispatch authorized wire requests
responsibility: Apply connection policy and deadlines, then execute requests with mutation replay tracking.

inputs.name: wireDispatch.context
inputs.description: Connection state and callbacks for this request: `attached` must be true, `methods` must include the request's method, and `pending` (not counting this request) must stay below `limits.pendingRequests`, or the request is refused before anything runs. `handle` runs the request, `explain` maps any error that is not a `RemoteFailure` to a `RemoteError`, `ledger` keeps mutation answers by id, and `limits` gives the `requestDeadlineMs` and `mutationDeadlineMs` deadlines; when `bound` is true, a mutation whose `input.epoch` differs from the context's `epoch` is refused as `request-expired`.

inputs.name: wireDispatch.request
inputs.description: The request to answer, already validated: `id` is echoed in the response and keys a mutation's ledger entry, `method` must be one the context's `methods` lists and decides whether the mutation rules apply, and for a mutation `input` is hashed with `method`, so the same `id` with a different method or input is refused as `request-conflict`.

outputs.name: wireDispatch
outputs.description: The response to the request, with its `id`: `ok: true` and `value` (`null` when the handler returns `null` or `undefined`), or `ok: false` with an `error` holding a `code` and `message` for a refusal, a handler or ledger failure, or a deadline. A mutation runs at most once per `id` and keeps running past a deadline, so a re-send either joins that work or is refused, and is never run a second time.
